about_the_game:
Join Noche L. Grim as she tests Shaylin Gear's newest invention in this short two-hour game. Noche will have to jump, run, and glide through challenge after challenge in this mini 3D platformer. With various types of platforms to land on or avoid, such as falling blocks, rotating cubes, or platforms that move each time you jump, it'll require skill and timing to maneuver through the obstacle course that is each level.

To unlock new levels, you need to collect the golden anglerfish scattered about. You can upgrade your movement abilities by collecting coins, and there are 100 coins per level. Unlock abilities such as double dash, triple jump, or faster running. Plus, there are secret areas with an extra life in each level.

Can you make it through all 15 levels and the special bonus stage? Find out in this free to play mini-adventure! This story is a spin-off from the "Epics of Noche" book series and takes place during Book Eight. However, you don't need to have read the books to enjoy this adventure.
